title: Stop Running Out Of Stock in Zoho Inventory #Shorts
description:
Stop missing low stock alerts in Zoho Inventory. Learn how to set reorder points and enable email notifications so you never run out of stock unexpectedly. Set it up once and you are done.

1. Go to Items › Edit Item
2. Set 'Reorder Point' quantity
3. Enable 'Low Stock Email' in Preferences

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

#Shorts #ZohoCRM #Zoho #BusinessAutomation

angle.problem: Low stock alerts are missed, leading to lost sales.
angle.solution: Set up 'Reorder Points' for automatic alerts.
angle.result: Never run out of stock unexpectedly again.
angle.hook: Running out of stock? Set this up in Zoho now.

lines.say: Running out of stock? Fix this in Zoho right now.
lines.tts: Running out of stock? Fix this in Zoho right now.

lines.say: Missing low stock alerts means unexpected inventory gaps, lost sales, and unhappy customers.
lines.tts: Missing low stock alerts means unexpected inventory gaps, lost sales, and unhappy customers.

lines.say: Fix it by configuring native reorder points directly inside your Zoho Inventory account.
lines.tts: Fix it by configuring native reorder points directly inside your Zoho Inventory account.

screen.heading: Items
screen.tip: Click on the item you want to edit

lines.say: First, navigate to your Items module in the left sidebar and click on the specific product to open its details page.
lines.tts: First, navigate to your Items module in the left sidebar and click on the specific product to open its details page.

lines.say: Next, click edit on that item and enter your desired numeric quantity into the Reorder Point field.
lines.tts: Next, click edit on that item and enter your desired numeric quantity into the Reorder Point field.

lines.say: Then, open your organization settings, go to preferences for items, and turn on low stock email alerts.
lines.tts: Then, open your organization settings, go to preferences for items, and turn on low stock email alerts.
